description: Discover CVEs using inclusive EPSS or percentile bounds, CVE year or dataset-addition recency; filters intersect and at least one is required. Examine one candidate page in the upstream FIRST order, which is not ranked by EPSS, so the first page does not hold the highest scores. Each serialized response surface fits 65536 UTF-8 bytes; budgetLimited and withheldCount disclose whole matches withheld, with nextOffset at the first withheld match. Year filtering can return an empty page with nextOffset; candidateTotal is a broad-query total, not an exact-year total. Continue with the same filters, limit, returned score date and nextOffset.

addedWithinDays.description: Dataset-addition recency relative to upstream present, independent of historical date.

date.description: UTC date YYYY-MM-DD from 2021-04-14 through today; omitted or blank selects latest available data.

limit.description: Requested candidates per page; positive safe integers above 10000 are clamped to 10000 before exact-year filtering.

offset.description: Candidate-space offset; use returned nextOffset for continuation.

year.description: Exact CVE year from 1999 through the current UTC year; candidate pages may contain no matches.

name: epss_query_threshold

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter_combination`: No qualifying filter is supplied or minimum exceeds maximum. `upstream_shape`: The candidate envelope, scores, snapshot or pagination are inconsistent. `snapshot_unavailable`: FIRST identifies the requested dated snapshot as unavailable. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

filters.description: Applied filters; combine with provenance scoreDates to pin continuation.

addedWithinDays.description: Dataset-addition recency relative to upstream present, independent of historical date.

date.description: UTC date YYYY-MM-DD from 2021-04-14 through today; omitted or blank selects latest available data.

year.description: Exact CVE year from 1999 through the current UTC year; candidate pages may contain no matches.

budgetLimited.description: True when complete matches were withheld to fit the response byte budget.

hasMore.description: Withheld matches or more candidates exist; not a guarantee of more year matches.

nextOffset.description: First withheld match candidate position, or next candidate page when no matches were withheld.

returnedCount.description: Whole records retained after filtering and response byte budgeting.

total.description: Exact total without a year filter; null with year.

totalRelation.description: Whether total is exact or unknown.

withheldCount.description: Matches inspected but withheld by the response byte budget; recovered with nextOffset.

provenance.description: Snapshot source and model metadata, including dates from filtered-out candidates.

status.description: verified: matching metadata; inferred: published schedule; unavailable: unknown.

scoreDates.description: Returned anchor or candidate score dates.

scores.description: Retained records from this candidate page.

items.description: Daily exploitation forecast and model attribution.

epss.description: 0–1 probability of observed exploitation within the next 30 days.

modelVersion.description: Verified or inferred scoring model version when available.

modelVersionSource.description: csv_header: verified metadata; published_schedule: inferred; unavailable: unknown.
